Young Leaders
You are the future of Corporate Real Estate (CRE)
 
See beyond what's now. And you’re challenging what’s always been. CoreNet Global is here to help you along your way. If you’re 35 or under and working in the exciting field of corporate real estate (or would like to), then you’re qualified for membership in CoreNet Global as a Young Leader.
CoreNet Global is the place for young professionals to connect, learn, grow, and belong to a worldwide association of nearly 10,000 members. It’s an unbeatable resource for knowledge, learning, and building your professional network and your career.
Wondering how to get started? Below you will find 5 key ways you can take the first step toward making your mark as a Young Leader at CoreNet Global.
Join us as a Young Leader today!
 
Bridging the Gap: New Membership Tier for Young Leaders Aged 36-40
We’re excited to launch the Young Leader Step Up Program, a new global membership option designed to support members as they transition out of the Young Leader category. If you’re between 36 and 40, you’ll now have access to a new, reduced price point that eases the jump to full membership—making it easier than ever to stay connected, engaged, and supported through the next phase of your career.
This option is available to both new and renewing members globally starting July 1. Eligibility is based on your birth year, so be sure your profile is up to date!
Unsure if we have your date of birth on file? Email us at help@corenetglobal.org and we will confirm for you!
Wondering what membership pricing looks like beyond the Young Leader tier?
Check My Regional Pricing
But don’t take our word for it.
Here’s what a few Young Leaders have to say about the value of CoreNet Global
 
“It all goes back to 'you get out of it what you put in'. … I have personally found the ROI for my time spent is greater than any other organization I have been a part of. … Aside from the friends and professional relationships I have built, I have been able to stay on top of all the latest real estate trends which is extremely valuable for both my clients and my firm.”
~Mike Brucato
Senior Director, Advisory & Transaction Services, Occupier
CBRE
"CoreNet Global has given me the opportunity to meet great, smart people, and to learn about many more aspects of the profession ... From a Young Leaders perspective, it has taught me about different career paths that I was not aware of and gave me the chance to learn about how the [profession] is evolving and how technology is changing the ways of working."
~ Lorena Compean Casmiro
Corporate Real Estate Operational Management, Asia-Pacific
HSBC
"The network is the most important thing – you meet the smartest and the best... I have met some really inspiring entrepreneurs and leaders who are innovating in their respective practices. I think the best part is – it’s very real – CoreNet Global is not some esoteric think tank – it is a real community ..."
~ Abhinav (Abe) Somani
Global CEO
Leverton Corporation
...the Young Leaders program made it really approachable and exciting to get to interact with people who are like [me]! … It was an amazing opportunity to learn new skills and make new relationships.
~Melissa Pesci
Vice President and Principal
HGA
“To me, it’s the connection with other Young Leaders, and with experts in corporate real estate on a global level. At all the events you get new information and insights on the various regions and what’s going on.”
~Martine Verhoeven
Business Development Manager, Building
Royal Haskoiningdhv

The CoreNet Global Central Texas chapter is dedicated to being an organization where those working in corporate real estate can come together and discuss best practice, new ideas, and sometimes just complain about the job! 
We’re a group of end-users, service providers, and students of all experience levels who genuinely want to help each other succeed. 
Through networking events, programs, and mentorship, we are advancing the high-bar of knowledge of corporate real estate in Austin and San Antonio.
If you’re interested in joining our crew and gaining lifelong industry friends, we would love to host you for an event or lunch and chat about how CoreNet Global Central Texas can boost you to the next level.
 
-Andrew McDonald, Director, Corporate Real Estate & Operations, Q2

Each Committee is chaired by a Board member, but every committee becomes stronger with greater member engagement & participation. Please email CoreNetGlobal@att.net to identify your interest, and we will forward your information to the appropriate Committee Chair.

Young Leaders
You are the future of Corporate Real Estate (CRE)
 
See beyond what's now. And you’re challenging what’s always been. CoreNet Global is here to help you along your way. If you’re 35 or under and working in the exciting field of corporate real estate (or would like to), then you’re qualified for membership in CoreNet Global as a Young Leader.
CoreNet Global is the place for young professionals to connect, learn, grow, and belong to a worldwide association of nearly 10,000 members. It’s an unbeatable resource for knowledge, learning, and building your professional network and your career.
Wondering how to get started? Below you will find 5 key ways you can take the first step toward making your mark as a Young Leader at CoreNet Global.
Join us as a Young Leader today!
 
Bridging the Gap: New Membership Tier for Young Leaders Aged 36-40
We’re excited to launch the Young Leader Step Up Program, a new global membership option designed to support members as they transition out of the Young Leader category. If you’re between 36 and 40, you’ll now have access to a new, reduced price point that eases the jump to full membership—making it easier than ever to stay connected, engaged, and supported through the next phase of your career.
This option is available to both new and renewing members globally starting July 1. Eligibility is based on your birth year, so be sure your profile is up to date!
Unsure if we have your date of birth on file? Email us at help@corenetglobal.org and we will confirm for you!

Message from the President
Welcome to CoreNet South East Florida Chapter’s Web Page.  Our South East Florida Chapter serves one of the most exciting and active RE markets in the nation.  Our chapter also holds a newly seated board of directors.  Our board are CRE professionals from Avison Young, Derektor, Iron Mountain, DHL, Tarkett, Bank of America and Macro Group. 
We're working on new events, educational content, mixers and networking opportunities for 2024. 
The new board remains steadfast in advancing the practice of corporate real estate in South Florida through professional development opportunities, publications, research, conferences and networking groups.  We aim to serve as the profession's voice and thought leader. 
We are a non-profit association, representing Corporate Real Estate Executives, Service Providers and Economic Development Organizations involved in activities related to real estate assets of large corporations. Our interaction allows for the End-Users to share best practices, go about common challenges and exchange comments on their Service Providers.  For the latter, the Chapter allows one to approach prospects and clients in a friendly ambiance, getting to know each other better.  EDO´s can showcase their respective regions and advantages to set foot in them.  In all, it is a win-win organization, where everybody gets value, grows their network, learning and having fun at the same time. 
It is an exciting time to be a practitioner of Corporate Real Estate in South Florida, where the region is experiencing tremendous growth and change.  We welcome you to join us at our events that are designed to help you learn, connect and grow.  Should you have any comments or questions, feel free to reach out to any of us on the board.  We will be happy to help you navigate our organization and get the most out of it. 
Best regards,
Hector Gualda  - President
